records.description_rewritten: Plänterwald is a wooded public recreation area bordering the former Spreepark in Treptow-Köpenick. Two gay directories describe a possible meeting area near the former amusement-park entrance, but the most recent firsthand forum description identified here is from 3 August 2024, before the current cutoff. The Spreepark itself is undergoing major redevelopment for a planned spring 2027 reopening, so older entrance descriptions and accessible paths may change.

additional_source_evidence.note: Second directory's undated cruising description and 2021 generic park reviews.
Official Berlin city event page documents spring 2027 planned Spreepark reopening.
